description: Get a time-limited download URL for a document (e.g. the executed/signed PDF or an uploaded source file). Returns the document name and a pre-signed downloadUrl valid for a limited window (expiresIn seconds) — fetch the bytes from that URL directly; it carries its own auth and does not need the API key. Pass a document ID from upload_document or from an envelope's documents[] (see get_envelope). This is the PDF alone, with no audit trail and no signed manifest, so it is not the verifiable evidence: for that, use get_evidence_bundle. Requires the documents:read scope on your API key.

documentId.description: Document ID (from upload_document, or from documents[].id on a get_envelope / list_envelopes result)

name: download_document
